description:
Remove the last references from the validation layer to `commands`: the test fixtures that drive an executor and the rustdoc that names executor items.

## Background

- The tests in `crates/jit/src/validation/repository.rs` (from about `:870`) build images through `crate::commands::CommandExecutor` (`:902-916`), `crate::commands::overrides_from_repo_changes`, `crate::commands::validation_overlay` and `capture_validation_image_with` (`:925-970`). They judge overlay validation, a command-layer composition of capture and report.
- `crates/jit/src/validation/mod.rs:7` links `effective_rules` on `crate::commands::CommandExecutor`; `crates/jit/src/validation/graph.rs:76-96` names `CommandExecutor::resolve_link_label`, `query_by_label`, `show_item` and `commands::claim::assert_valid_actor`.
- `jit::test_harness` builds closed images without an executor.

## Success Criteria

- [hard] REQ-01: No code, test or rustdoc under `crates/jit/src/validation/` names a `crate::commands` item.
- [hard] REQ-02: Report tests that need only an image build it through the shared test image builder; tests that judge overlay capture live in the commands test module; each asserts the property it asserted before.

## Notes

- Written against the code as it stands after the changes this one follows; line citations name current code.
title: Validation-layer tests and prose stop naming commands
